adjudication.rationale: The diff adds `EmbedController#best`, which builds `@topic_view = TopicView.new(topic_id, current_user, {best: 5})` and sets `discourse_expires_in 1.minute`, but the new controller spec doesn’t assert anything about cache headers/variation with `current_user`, so the review comment about a missing test for caching behavior is diff-grounded. Separately, `TopicEmbed.absolutize_urls` contains explicit port logic (`prefix << ":#{uri.port}" if uri.port != 80 && uri.port != 443`) that isn’t covered by the added specs, so the “port handling” test gap is also grounded. However, the mention of “non-HTTP schemes” is less applicable because `TopicEmbed.import` returns early unless the URL matches `^https?://`, so that part overreaches.
